$comment: Measured facts for HIV provirus excision. Dual-guide CRISPR flanking the integrated HIV genome. The AAV vector is the delivery vehicle; the DNA sequence is what makes it selective — only latently infected cells contain the LTR targets.

subject.mechanism: Dual CRISPR-Cas9 excision of integrated HIV provirus via LTR targeting
subject.therapeutic_effect: Provirus removed from host genome, cell retains normal function
subject.selectivity: Only cells with integrated HIV LTR sequences are cut
subject.model: humanized mice (BLT model) + human CD4+ T cell cultures
subject.efficacy: 60-80% proviral excision in infected cells in vitro, 40-60% in vivo

facts.note: Dash et al. 2019: CRISPR + LASER ART achieved complete HIV elimination in 2/7 humanized mice. The dual-guide LTR approach removes the entire provirus as a single excision event.

data.note: 40% deletion (provirus fully removed) + 3% degradation + 12% indel (LTR disrupted) = 55% functional cure per cell. 30% uncut is the main challenge — delivery efficiency to resting T cells.
